text.zh: 一把草编座面的木椅，让人想起他早年在荷兰画过的农民椅子。
text.en: A wooden chair with a straw seat, recalling the peasant chairs he painted in the Netherlands in the 1880s.

text.zh: 椅子上放着他的烟斗和烟草袋，也许代表简单的家常慰藉。父亲去世后不久，他曾画过父亲的烟斗。
text.en: His pipe and tobacco pouch rest on the seat, perhaps simple, homely comforts. Shortly after his father died, he had sketched his father's pipe.

text.zh: 椅子左后方有一个签着"Vincent"的矮箱子，里面像是发芽的洋葱。它的含义至今是个谜。
text.en: Behind the chair is a low box signed "Vincent", holding what look like sprouting onions. Its meaning remains a mystery.

text.zh: 真实的墙是刷白的，但他把它画成了浅蓝绿色，好衬托黄色的椅子。
text.en: The real walls were whitewashed, but he painted them light turquoise to set off the yellow chair.

text.zh: 他把自己的椅子画在明亮的白天里；高更的椅子则画在夜晚的灯光下。
text.en: He painted his own chair in bright daylight; Gauguin's chair was painted at night, by lamplight.

text.zh: 卧室那幅画里，也有两把几乎一样的椅子。
text.en: Two very similar chairs appear in The Bedroom.

label.en: See the two chairs in the bedroom

alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, Van Gogh's Chair, 1888

text.zh: 1888年11月，高更来到阿尔勒不久，梵高画了两把椅子：一把是他自己的，一把是高更的。两幅画是一对。
text.en: In November 1888, soon after Gauguin arrived in Arles, Van Gogh painted two chairs: his own, and Gauguin's. The two paintings were a pair.

title.zh: 第二幕 · 白天与夜晚

text.zh: 他自己的椅子简朴，画在白天，用黄与蓝；高更的扶手椅优雅精致，画在夜晚的煤气灯下，用红与绿。这盏煤气灯，是他一个月前才装的，部分原因是想让高更愿意来南方。
text.en: His own chair is plain, painted by day in yellow and blue. Gauguin's armchair is elegant, painted at night under gaslight, in red and green. He had installed the gaslight just a month earlier, partly to encourage Gauguin to come south.

title.zh: 第三幕 · 分开的椅子

text.zh: 一个月后，黄房子里的生活破碎了，高更离开了阿尔勒。今天，梵高的椅子在伦敦，高更的椅子在阿姆斯特丹。
text.en: A month later, life in the Yellow House fell apart, and Gauguin left Arles. Today Van Gogh's chair is in London; Gauguin's is in Amsterdam.

final.zh: 两把空椅子，一把在伦敦，一把在阿姆斯特丹。
final.en: Two empty chairs: one in London, one in Amsterdam.
